blocks.text: COTABATO CITY, Philippines — Three people, including a female barangay chair, were wounded in an ambush in Barangay Tumbras, Kadayangan, Special Geographic Area (SGA) of the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM), on Monday afternoon, Nov. 16. In his report to the Police Regional Office-Bangsamoro Autonomous Region (PRO-BAR), Lt. Julito Gonzales, Kadayangan police chief, identified the victim as Barangay Tumbras Chair Fatima Mokamad, her son, and an employee of the Ministry of Social Services and Development (MSSD). The victims were brought to an undisclosed hospital for treatment. READ: 3 killed in separate shooting incidents in BARMM Police investigators said the […]...
